changelog:
- Description updated: works out of the box, optional tools enhance quality, internet required for YouTube
- Added OpenClaw metadata: declares summarize as required binary
- Added security clarifications: no data uploaded, sub-agent has strict no-install instructions
- Expanded setup.py documentation in README
- Fixed display name on ClawHub: TubeScribe (was Tubescribe)
summary: YouTube video summarizer with speaker detection, formatted documents, and audio output. Works out of the box with macOS built-in TTS. Optional recommended tools (pandoc, ffmpeg, mlx-audio) enhance quality. Requires internet for YouTube access. No paid APIs or subscriptions. Use when user sends a YouTube URL or asks to summarize/transcribe a YouTube video.
